overall_notes: The paper presents a comprehensive evaluation framework for interleaved text-and-image generation. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundancy and inconsistent formatting. All yes/no answers were correctly identified. The paper robustly evaluates both automatic (InterleavedEval with GPT-4o/LLaVA) and human evaluation methods with clear criteria across five defined aspects.
